Class ServicePoint

java.lang.Object
org.example.Model.ServicePoint
Direct Known Subclasses:
SimulationEngine.Boarding, SimulationEngine.Customs, SimulationEngine.FastTrackSecurity, SimulationEngine.NormalCheckin, SimulationEngine.RegularSecurity, SimulationEngine.SelfCheckin
public abstract class ServicePoint extends Object
Represents an abstract service point in the airport simulation. A service point manages a queue of passengers, service execution, event scheduling, and performance statistics such as utilization, throughput, waiting time, response time, and queue length. Concrete service points such as check-in, security, customs, and boarding extend this class and implement their own service logic.

    • ServicePoint

      public ServicePoint(SimulationEngine engine, String servicePointName)
      Creates a new service point. The constructor initializes the queue, engine reference, service point name, performance counters, queue statistics, and base service mean.
      Parameters:
      engine - simulation engine that owns this service point
      servicePointName - name of the service point

      public double getBaseServiceMean()
      Returns:
      The global baseline mean service time used as a starting point for all service point calculations.

    • updateBaseServiceMean

      public void updateBaseServiceMean(double newBaseMean)
      Updates the base service mean of this service point. The current service mean is reset to the new base value. If the service generator is a normal distribution, its mean is updated.
      Parameters:
      newBaseMean - new base service mean

    • adjustServiceTime

      public void adjustServiceTime(double factor)
      Adjusts the service time parameters using the given factor. The factor is limited to an allowed range and used to update temporary mean and standard deviation values for the service generator.
      Parameters:
      factor - adjustment factor for service speed

    • finalizeStatistics

      public void finalizeStatistics()
      Finalizes queue statistics at the end of the simulation. The remaining queue area is added using the simulation end time.

    • handleArrival

      public void handleArrival(Passenger passenger)
      Handles the arrival of a passenger to this service point. If the server is free, service starts immediately and a completion event is scheduled. Otherwise, the passenger is added to the queue.
      Parameters:
      passenger - arriving passenger

    • handleCompletion

      public void handleCompletion(Passenger passenger)
      Handles service completion for a passenger. The method updates timestamps, performance statistics, starts service for the next queued passenger if available, and routes the completed passenger forward.
      Parameters:
      passenger - passenger that completed service

    • reset

      public void reset()
      Resets this service point to its initial state. Queue contents, counters, statistics, and adjustment values are cleared.
